test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

15, 16, 32, 35, 140, 145, ?
solution:
**Given:**

15, 16, 32, 35, 140, 145,?

**Logic:** **Consecutive odd numbers are added alternatively and multiply by consecutive even numbers alternatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46e46c5cb91f2c17700a4badf12812ef32f4593b193056d48365e97ebf3e8f72.png] 

Here,** '870'** is the next number.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
